headline: HSBC Reorganises India Support Roles, Centralising Finance Functions
summary: HSBC is reorganising its support roles in India, centralising finance functions across multiple cities including Chennai and impacting hundreds of jobs.
why: Major multinational banking groups frequently restructure back-office and operational hubs to optimize operating costs and centralize global functions.

impacts.name: HSBC Holdings
impacts.why: Operational restructuring of support functions impacts corporate cost structure.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
